mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns: lower rates compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, producing positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising UNRATE and falling INDPRO fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), reduced liquidity and higher discount rates cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during defined monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year inflation (computed from CPIAUCSL) is below 2.0%, it signals a stable price environment that supports corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL (yoy) is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (computed from GDPC1) exceeds 2.0%, it signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 (qtr growth) exceeds 2.0%.
